text: long: Heb. the length thereof, etc
not fail thee a man: Heb. there shall not be a man cut off
towards this place: Or, in this place
and an oath be laid upon him: Heb. and he require an oath of him
be put to the worse: Or, be smitten | in: Or, towards
in the cities of their land: Heb. in the land of their gates
in this house: Or, toward this house
so long as they live: Heb. all the days which | in the land: Heb. upon the face of the land
this house which I have built: Heb. thy Name is called upon this house
they carry away captives unto a land far off or near: Heb. they that take them captives carry them away
bethink themselves: Heb. bring back to their heart
unto the prayer that is made: Heb. to the prayer of this place
